lines.text: Here's what nine ninety-nine actually gets you.
One course. Any of seventy-four languages.
A quick chat about why you're learning.
A level test, so you don't start at hello.
Fifty lessons, written for you, one at a time.
A passport that fills up as you learn.
Your first two weeks of lessons, included.
After that, five ninety-nine a month. For all your courses.
And every lesson you've made stays yours. Forever.
Borderless. A course built around you.
